rationale.quality-debt: Empirically characterizes functional API misuses in LLM-generated Python and Java code.
rationale.ai-review: Dr.Fix uses LLM stages to detect, classify, and reason about misuses.
rationale.remediation-gating: Detection and refusal filter candidates before autonomous LLM repair.
rationale.framework: Dr.Fix specifies a reusable staged detection-reasoning-repair pipeline.
rationale.built-system: Authors implement and benchmark Dr.Fix across models and languages.
rationale.assistive: Study targets snippet-level IDE completion and infilling initiated by developers.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports functional correctness, redundancy, omissions, hallucinations, and intent misalignment.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled generation tasks characterize three third-party code models.
